video_caption: The video opens with the seven members of the K-Pop group BTS, including J-Hope making hand gestures, clapping and laughing while sitting in front of a dark backdrop with "BTS LOVE YOURSELF 轉 Tear" logos. A textual overlay at the top of the screen reads "yoongified93." Subtitles in Spanish state: "¡WOW! ¡Vamos! ¡WOW!" (WOW! Let's go! WOW!). The scene then cuts to a man with long, curly brown hair wearing a pink hoodie with "LOVE YOURSELF" written on it. He shows a small notebook to the camera, which is a mini version of the BTS album "Love Yourself: Tear," adorned with photos of the group members. He says in English, "I've got my questions here handy-dandy pocket on my little notebook," with Spanish subtitles reading, "Tengo mis preguntas aquí a la mano en mi cuaderno. pocket, on my little notebook, yeah. So yeah." (I have my questions here at hand in my notebook. pocket, on my little notebook, yeah. So yeah.). The BTS members react with surprise and laughter at the interviewer's fan merchandise, with RM (man in a light blue collared shirt) laughing heartily. Subtitles: "¡Wow! ¡Wow! Yeah. I had to come, I had to come prepare." (Wow! Wow! Sí. Tuve que venir, tuve que venir preparado.). Jin (man in a white shirt with a black jacket) asks in English, "Are you ARMY?", and the interviewer enthusiastically replies, "I am ARMY! Of course, I am ARMY!" Subtitles: "SJ: ¿Eres ARMY? Sí, yo soy ARMY. Claro que soy un ARMY." (SJ: Are you ARMY? Yes, I am ARMY. Of course, I am an ARMY.). The interviewer adds, "It's gonna be a bit difficult reading my questions 'cause there's photos of you all over this book," eliciting more smiles from the group. Spanish subtitles appear again: "Va a ser un poco difícil leer mis preguntas porque hay fotos de ustedes por todos lados." (It's going to be a bit difficult reading my questions because there are photos of you all over this book.). Jimin (man in a black shirt with a beige collar) smiles and nods as the interviewer continues, "Yeah, we're gonna we're gonna be at that. Thank you, thank you." Subtitles: "Sí, vamos a tener que lidiar con eso. Gracias gracias ~" (Yes, we're going to have to deal with that. Thank you, thank you ~). The interviewer then congratulates them on their album, "Love Yourself: Tear," and asks RM about the message they are trying to convey with this new era. RM explains, "Basically, love is a complex, right? And there are some sides that make us really feel bad or depressed... There's tears, there could be sadness. So this time we want to focus on some of the parts of love that we want to like run away from. So the name is 'Tear' and the main single title is gonna be 'Fake Love'." He adds, "We want to say that if you are untrue to yourself, the love won't last. And the love could be between one person and another person." Spanish subtitles translate his speech. The BTS members, including J-Hope, Jin, Suga (man in a beige shirt), Jimin, V (man in a yellow long-sleeved shirt), and Jungkook (man in a black shirt behind Jin), listen attentively throughout the interview.

The video segment captures an interview with the K-pop group BTS, featuring seven members seated in a row and an interviewer opposite them. The background is a dark blue curtain with repeated "BTS LOVE YOURSELF 轉 Tear" logos. The interviewer, a man with curly brown hair wearing a pink "LOVE YOURSELF" hoodie, asks V if he felt pressure releasing "Singularity" as the album's first song, stating, "MC: De algún modo estableciste las expectativas de todo, ¿no fue un poco de presión para ti?" (MC: You kind of set the expectations for everything, wasn't that a little bit of pressure for you?). V, wearing a light yellow shirt and glasses, responds with "TH: Por supuesto" (TH: Of course), which elicits laughter from RM in a light blue shirt. V further explains, "TH: Eh... bailar en solitario es muy difícil. Muy duro" (TH: Uh... solo dancing is very difficult. Very hard.). The interviewer then asks, "MC: ¿Fue una sensación extraña no tener a tu grupo a tu alrededor?" (MC: Was it a weird feeling to not have your group around you?), and V confirms with "TH: Sí" (TH: Yes). Jimin, wearing a black collared shirt, smiles and gestures towards V, remarking, "Es mi primera vez viendo a V trabajando tan duro en el baile" (It's my first time seeing V working so hard on dancing). The interviewer claps, saying, "MC: Lo hizo bien, lo hizo bien" (MC: He did it well, he did it well), and RM adds, "RM: Lo hizo bien" (RM: He did it well), as all the BTS members join in clapping and smiling for V. Finally, the interviewer transitions the conversation, saying, "MC: Por supuesto, hablemos del significado de sus canciones. Por supuesto, lo mencionaste antes" (MC: Of course, let's talk about the meaning of your songs. Of course, you mentioned it earlier.).

In a professionally set interview, an interviewer with long curly hair, wearing a pink "LOVE YOURSELF" hoodie, sits on the left, actively speaking and gesturing with a book in his hand. He is addressing the seven members of the K-pop group BTS, who are seated in a row of black chairs facing him, with a dark backdrop featuring "BTS LOVE YOURSELF 承 Tear" logos. The interviewer asks, "¿Sientes una obligación moral, como un grupo exitoso internacionalmente alrededor del mundo- de hacer canciones con conciencia social? ¿Esto debería ser una necesidad para las personas con el nivel de fama que ustedes tienen?" (Do you feel a moral obligation, as a successful international group around the world- to make socially conscious songs? Should this be a necessity for people with your level of fame?). The camera then cuts to show the BTS members, including RM in a light blue shirt, J-Hope in a similar light blue shirt, Suga in a beige shirt, Jimin in a black shirt, V in a light yellow shirt, Jin in a dark jacket, and Jungkook in a yellow shirt. They are listening intently, with various expressions of contemplation. Suga, wearing a beige shirt with a black collar, responds, "No creo que no solo los artistas exitosos... Creo que cualquiera con influencia debería estar intentando enviar un mensaje positivo. Si más y más gente emitiera estos mensajes positivos y energía positiva, Eso volvería el mundo más positivo y mejor para todos." (I don't think it's just successful artists... I think that anyone with influence should be trying to send a positive message. If more and more people emitted these positive messages and positive energy, it would make the world more positive and better for everyone). The interviewer then smiles and agrees, saying, "Eso fue hermoso, me encantó. Los BBMAs están cerca, por lo que estoy muy emocionado." (That was beautiful, I loved that. The BBMAs are close, so I'm very excited). A watermark "yoongified93" is visible at the top center of the screen throughout the clip.

The video opens with a man with long curly hair, wearing a pink "LOVE YOURSELF" hoodie, gesturing as he speaks to someone off-screen. Spanish subtitles read, "Estamos muy emocionados por tenerlos aquí para que presenten Fake Love." (We are very excited to have you here to present Fake Love.) The scene then cuts to a wide shot of the seven members of BTS sitting in a row, facing the speaker. From left to right: J-Hope (light blue short-sleeved collared shirt, black pants), Jin (black blazer over white t-shirt), RM (light blue short-sleeved collared shirt, black pants), Suga (beige short-sleeved collared shirt), Jimin (black short-sleeved collared shirt, black pants), Jungkook (yellow long-sleeved shirt), and V (light yellow short-sleeved collared shirt, glasses). The background is a dark wall with "LOVE YOURSELF" and "BTS" logos repeated. Spanish subtitles appear: "MC: ¿Qué es lo que les emociona más que ARMY viva durante esta nueva era de BTS?" (MC: What are you most excited for ARMY to experience during this new era of BTS?). The scene cuts back to the MC, still gesturing, as the subtitles continue, "MC: Porque la banda ha cambiado mucho comparado con sus inicios." (MC: Because the band has changed a lot compared to its beginnings.). RM is seen smiling while listening. J-Hope then speaks, and the subtitles show, "JH: Los nuevos visuales ~" (JH: The new visuals ~). Jungkook adds, "JK: Nuevas canciones." (JK: New songs.). V chimes in, "TH: Nuevo maquillaje." (TH: New makeup.). The MC enthusiastically agrees, "MC: Por supuesto." (MC: Of course.). RM points at V and says, "RM: Y nuevas gafas. Siempre cambiando su cabello ~" (RM: And new glasses. Always changing his hair ~). The MC adds, "MC: Cabello hermoso." (MC: Beautiful hair.). The MC then speaks about their journey, "Han pasado por una locura de viaje. Si piensan en el 2013 cuando comenzaron, y ven lo que se acerca para ustedes," (You've been on a crazy journey. If you think back to 2013 when you started, and look at what is approaching for all of you now.). Jimin is shown listening intently with a slight smile. The MC asks, "¿Cuál dirían que ha sido su mayor cambio como banda?" (What would you say has been your biggest change as a band?). RM looks at Jungkook and points, stating, "RM: ve su forma." (RM: Look at his shape.). The MC responds, "MC: Está en forma, se ve bien." (MC: He's fit, he looks good.). Jungkook, in the yellow shirt, flexes his bicep. RM continues, "RM: Él era como un niño chiquito la primera vez que lo vimos, Pero ahora es como el hombre más grande de-" (RM: He was like a small child when we first saw him, but now he's like the biggest man in-). The MC laughs and gestures, "MC: Es el más grande. No quieren ir en contra de él. Yo no tengo nada, ve esto." (MC: He's the biggest. You don't want to go against him. I've got nothing, look at this.). RM adds, "RM: Igual yo." (RM: Me too.), and V agrees, "TH: También yo." (TH: Me too.). RM then points at V's hair, "RM: Ve su cabello." (RM: Look at his hair.). The MC praises, "MC: Cabello hermoso." (MC: Beautiful hair.). The MC laughs and comments, "MC: Muchos cambios. Ve tu cara hahaha. Todo eso." (MC: Many changes. Look at your face hahaha. All of that.).

The video segment opens with the seven members of BTS seated in front of a dark backdrop with "BTS LOVE YOURSELF" logos. The camera then cuts to a young man with curly hair wearing a pink "LOVE YOURSELF" hoodie, who is interviewing them. He asks, "MC: ¿Qué se dirían? ¿Tendrían algún consejo para ustedes mismos? (MC: What would you say? Would you have any advice for yourselves?) MC: Porque estoy seguro de que no tenían idea de que las cosas serían así para ustedes. (MC: Because I'm sure you would have had no idea that things were going to go this way for you.)" The scene returns to BTS. Jungkook, in a light blue button-up shirt, suggests, "JK: Por favor estudia inglés. (JK: Please study English.)," to which Jin, in a dark suit, adds, "SJ: Sí, por favor estudia inglés. (SJ: Yes, please study English.)" RM, wearing a light blue polo shirt with a white collar, laughs, covering his face. The MC then responds, "MC: Estudiar inglés ~ (MC: Study English ~)" RM then offers, "RM: Y Japonés también. (RM: And Japanese too.)," and Jungkook chimes in with "JK: Porfis. (JK: Please.)" J-Hope, also in a light blue shirt, looks up and says, "JH: Hey, J-HOPE, tu esperanza es de mucha energía. Anímate. Da tu esperanza a toda la gente. (JH: Hey, J-HOPE, your hope is very energetic. Cheer up. Give your hope to all the people.)" RM, smiling, then points at himself and humorously advises, "RM: Hey, Namjoon, no te llames "Rap Monster", eres un humano. (RM: Hey, Namjoon, don't name yourself "Rap Monster", you're a human.)" The MC affirms, "MC: Sí, eres un humano, no un monstruo. (MC: Yes, you're a human, not a monster.)" Jin agrees with a "SJ: Sí~ (SJ: Yes~)" and RM adds, "RM: No eres un monstruo, eres un humano hermoso. (RM: You're not a monster, you're a beautiful human.)" He playfully nudges Jimin, who is in a black collared shirt, making Jimin laugh and lean forward. RM then laughs and gestures towards Jimin, saying "RM: Te amo bro ~ (RM: I love you bro ~)" Taehyung, dressed in a light yellow collared shirt and glasses, smiles and points to himself, giving advice, "TH: Hey, Taetae ~ Estoy orgulloso de ti ~ Haz tu mejor esfuerzo. (TH: Hey, Taetae ~ I'm proud of you ~ Do your best.)" Jimin points to himself and encourages, "JM: Hey, Jimin. Eres bueno. Sigue adelante ~ (JM: Hey, Jimin. You're good. Keep going ~)" The MC nods and says, "MC: Bien. (MC: Nice.)" RM adds, "RM: Sigue adelante. (RM: Keep going.)" Jin then advises himself, "SJ: Hey, Jin. Las prácticas de baile son difíciles... (T/N: Quiso decir, practica el baile más duro) SJ: (Practica) Más... (SJ: Hey, Jin. Dance practices are hard... (T/N: He meant, practice dance harder) SJ: (Practice) More...)," laughing as he bows his head. Suga, in a beige short-sleeved collared shirt, emphatically states, "SG: Por favor estudia inglés. POR FAVOR. (SG: Please study English. PLEASE.)" RM once again laughs, bowing his head as the members smile, and the video concludes with the text overlay "Igual yo, me encantó. (Me too, I loved it.)".

The video segment opens with seven young men, the members of BTS, seated in a row on chairs, facing forward, dressed in casual shirts and pants against a dark background adorned with repeated "BTS LOVE YOURSELF" logos. The man on the far left (J-Hope) has his arms crossed, while the man in the middle (RM) and the one on the far right (V) look forward. A light-skinned interviewer (MC) with curly brown hair, wearing a pink "LOVE YOURSELF" hoodie, sits opposite them, speaking and gesturing with his hands. On-screen text reads, "MC: La última vez hablamos de UNICEF, ser recíprocos, pero no solo son ustedes quienes son recíprocos." (MC: Last time we talked about UNICEF, giving back, but it's not just you who are giving back.) The camera then focuses on the MC as he gestures with a small, colorful booklet, addressing one of the BTS members whose back is visible. He continues, with text "MC: Sus fans, ARMY, han sido inspirados por ustedes para reciprocar. He visto proyectos hechos por fans, en los que la gente dan miles de dólares a la caridad, en particular a UNICEF." (MC: Your fans, ARMY, have been inspired by you to give back. I've seen fan projects where people give thousands of dollars to charity, particularly UNICEF.) The scene returns to the full group, attentively listening, before cutting back to the MC posing a question with a hand gesture: "MC: ¿Por qué piensan que es tan importante reciprocar?" (MC: Why do you think it's so important to give back?) A close-up shows RM, wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt with a white collar, looking up thoughtfully before he begins to speak, gesturing with his hands. The on-screen text displays his words: "RM: Algunas veces en verdad sentimos que recibimos demasiado amor, incluso más del que merecemos. Para alguien que recibe tanto amor, es importante ser recíprocos. Porque, sabes, el amor no es como un recurso. Podemos dar y dar y dar por todo el mundo. Así que, simplemente sentimos que es importante reciprocar." (RM: Sometimes we truly feel like we're getting so much love, even more than we deserve. For someone who receives so much love, it's important to give back. Because, you know, love is not like a resource. We can give and give and give all over the world. So, we simply feel like it's important to give back.) During his speech, the MC is seen nodding and smiling in response, and RM pauses briefly with a slightly amused expression around 0:43 as a distinct honking sound is heard off-screen, before he continues his explanation.

A young man with long curly brown hair and a pink "LOVE YOURSELF" hoodie, the MC, sits on a black chair and energetically speaks to someone off-screen, gesturing with his hands. He poses a question about BTS's next step, recalling how Suga previously aimed for the BBMAs (Billboard Music Awards). The scene frequently cuts between the MC and the seven members of BTS, seated in black chairs against a dark backdrop adorned with "BTS LOVE YOURSELF 轉 Tear" logos. The BTS members, dressed in various casual shirts and pants, listen attentively. When the MC asks about the next step, Jimin, wearing a black collared shirt, playfully kicks his leg out twice as if taking a literal step, prompting laughter from his bandmates, particularly RM (in a light blue button-down shirt) who covers his face in amusement, and J-Hope (in a light blue patterned shirt) who laughs heartily. Suga, in a beige shirt, then suggests with a mischievous smile, "¿Grammy?" (Grammy?), which elicits more laughter and expressions of surprise and delight from the other members, especially RM who buries his face in his hands, and Jin (in a black suit jacket) who throws his head back laughing. The MC, with a big smile, acknowledges Suga's ambitious statement, implying that the Grammys might indeed be the group's next goal. Spanish subtitles translate the dialogue throughout the video.

The video opens with seven young men (BTS) seated in a row, with the one in a light blue collared shirt (RM) speaking and gesturing with his hand to his head, then smiling widely. Spanish subtitles display, "Vamos a ver. Los Grammys son otro mundo, creo que él lo dijo la primera vez. RM: Creo que no está bromeando." (Let's see. The Grammys are another world, I think he said it the first time. RM: I think he's not joking.). The scene then shifts to a young man with long curly hair in a pink hoodie (MC) sitting opposite two of the BTS members (mostly seen from the back), speaking and gesturing. Spanish subtitles read, "MC: Y claro que ARMY los conoce por muchas cosas, hay muchas razones por las que ARMY los ama." (MC: And of course, ARMY knows them for many things, there are many reasons why ARMY loves them.). All seven BTS members are then shown again as the MC continues speaking, asking in Spanish, "MC: Pero si hubiera una sola cosa por la que BTS quisiera ser recortado, digamos que en 20 años. ¿Qué sería?" (MC: But if there was just one thing that BTS would want to be remembered for, let's say in 20 years. What would it be?). The man in the black collared shirt (Jimin) responds, gesturing with both hands, with the Spanish subtitle stating, "JM: Me gustaría que fuéramos recordados como personas que siempre se mostraron con sinceridad." (JM: I would like us to be remembered as people who always showed sincerity.). The MC praises them, holding a small colorful album, and congratulates the man in the light blue long-sleeved shirt (J-Hope) on his "Hope World" album, to which Jimin enthusiastically points at J-Hope. The MC then presents a box of custom-decorated donuts featuring BT21 characters and the words "CONGRATS BTS" and "LOVE YOURSELF," which the members receive with delight. J-Hope takes the box, and he and Jimin lean in to smell the donuts, expressing their appreciation with "Gracias gracias ~ Está hermoso, y huele muy bien." (Thank you thank you ~ It's beautiful, and it smells very good.). The video transitions to a pink J-14 branded screen encouraging viewers to subscribe, followed by a brief TV color bar test pattern, before cutting back to the MC touching his hair and RM confirming it looks good. The segment concludes with all BTS members laughing at a comment, with the Spanish subtitle reading, "MC: Bien, estamos listos. Tas loco." (MC: Good, we're ready. You're crazy.).
